summary: Mars Base is an interactive educational web application inspired by NASA's space exploration missions, designed for children aged 8–12. It transforms learning into an immersive experience where young explorers discover Mars, explore its environment, operate robotic systems, and manage their own Mars research base. The platform combines real NASA scientific data, interactive 3D environments, educational games, and hands-on scientific challenges. Noier Base is an interactive educational web application inspired by NASA's space exploration missions, designed for children aged 8–12. It transforms learning into an immersive experience where young explorers discover Mars, explore its environment, operate robotic systems, and manage their own Mars research base. The platform combines real NASA scientific data, interactive 3D environments, educational games, and hands-on scientific challenges. Through three specialized laboratories, users can experiment, solve engineering problems, and understand space science concepts. Mars Base aims to develop curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, and STEM skills while making space exploration accessible, engaging, and enjoyable.
